source: Real `claude -p` run with --plugin-dir on the synthetic test project, 2026-11-25. Answer abridged (lines kept verbatim, tables flattened).
prompt: Which endpoints of orders and payments are broken, and which does nobody call?
answer:
I analysed only the exported files in observability/. Nothing was sent to production.
Broken: orders DELETE /orders/{id} — 1,080 / 14,580 5xx (7.4%), about 12 a day for 90 days.
Broken: payments POST /payments — no 502s until 2026-11-22, since then 60 a day (about 2.3% of payment creations). Check what changed around 2026-11-22.
Not called in the window: orders POST /orders/{id}/repeat — zero calls in 90 days (confidence high). payments GET /payments/export — may be periodic; 30 days could miss it.
Undocumented: orders GET /orders/export — 1,800 calls, Datadog records it as its own route, missing from routes.txt.
"Not seen" doesn't prove an endpoint is dead. I haven't changed or deprecated anything.
